fix_code:
n = int(input())
A = list(map(int, input().split()))
count = 0

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    indices = [index for index, value in enumerate(A) if value == i]
    if len(indices) == 2 and indices[1] - indices[0] == 2:
        count += 1

print(count)
